$comment: STAGE 1 · build config for the NivXMachines Workspace frontend.
INERT BY DESIGN. Only the config at a deployment's configured Root
Directory is read. The repo-root vercel.json (which builds
apps/nivxray-xdr) is untouched and still governs the existing
deployment, so adding this file CANNOT change what the current
deployment produces. It takes effect only for a deployment whose
Root Directory is set to `frontend`.
Why each field exists:
buildCommand   CI=false because CRA promotes warnings to errors when
CI is truthy, and this app carries 9 react-hooks
exhaustive-deps advisories (see
memory/WORKSPACE_BUILD_VERIFICATION.md). They are
lint advisories, not defects; fixing them changes
effect timing, so they are not being touched during
a migration.
rewrites       WITHOUT this, /auto-investigate returns 404 on a
static host while / works — verified locally against
the built bundle. That is the exact symptom that
looks like 'the tool is missing'.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is NOT set here on purpose: CRA inlines env
vars at build time, so it must be supplied by the deployment that
builds this app and must point at the backend whose DATABASE the
Workspace is meant to read. Preview and production are separate
databases (verified: the preview admin credential returns 401 on the
production host), so baking the wrong one silently shows the wrong
data.
